coverage.rule: a ticker longer than 4 characters with no hyphen is stored in TAQ as root=first 4 chars + suffix=the rest; a pull that queries the whole ticker as the root finds nothing

panel_meta.source: WRDS taqm_2026 complete_nbbo_* (millisecond TAQ NBBO), direct psycopg2
panel_meta.measure: time-band simple mean/median NBBO quoted FULL spread in bps, 09:45-15:45, crossed/locked excluded, >2000bp excluded. QUOTED, not EFFECTIVE: no trade-quote join here - effective-spread computation (Holden-Jacobsen) is the daemon's job. Full spread: halve for one-way (COST_BPS_ONE_WAY convention, Order 18).
panel_meta.purpose: Order 18 s1: calibration anchor for the AGK floor ruling - where TAQ resolves a name, the DECLARED liquid band retires.

bias_ledger.name: quoted_not_effective
bias_ledger.detail: marketable orders execute inside the NBBO; effective spread is typically 0.5-0.9x quoted

bias_ledger.name: intraday_time_band_0945_1545
bias_ledger.detail: the open and the close are the widest parts of the session and are excluded from the panel

bias_ledger.name: message_weighted_not_time_weighted
bias_ledger.detail: quote messages cluster in active, tight-spread moments, so a mean over messages is not a mean over time
bias_ledger.resolvable_by: time-weight by quote duration in the SQL

summary.note: names whose band did NOT retire carry no measured cost; their verdicts are still reported across the declared band
